verdict.rationale: Workers' own docs state that static assets deploy to Cloudflare's CDN and cache for fast rendering, on Cloudflare's global network. That directly covers serving static assets from a global CDN with edge caching. The evidence is only a single summary line, though, with no detail on how caching behaves or how it is configured. Missing for 10: in-depth static-assets docs (cache-control/TTL configuration, invalidation, edge-cache behavior), independent or hands-on corroboration of Workers static-asset performance.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve static assets faster using a global CDN with edge caching
